prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On the afternoon of the collision in League City, Texas, Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of a two-lane roadway when the vehicle behind them, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper at a moderate speed. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back immediately afterward. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle did not stop in time and confirmed that the contact occurred as Driver 1 described. Two witnesses at the scene gave statements consistent with that account, and scene photographs show rear-end damage to both vehicles that corresponds with the reported impact. A Passenger seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle was present during the incident, and both the responding officer and the witnesses confirmed the Passenger's presence. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 is listed as the insured driver on the policy for that vehicle. The officer noted that the reported back injury is consistent with the type and force of this collision. Paramedics were called to the scene, and Driver 1 was transported for evaluation.
